title: Decode Ways

description.text: You have intercepted a secret message encoded as a string of numbers. The message is decoded via the mapping: "1" -> 'A', "2" -> 'B', ..., "26" -> 'Z'. Given a string s containing only digits, return the number of ways to decode it. Return 0 if it cannot be decoded.
notes: Imported automatically from third-party problem datasets.

constraints: s contains only digits and may contain leading zero(s)
